author: reek
body: Reusable authentication client for Codex web apps compiled by the html plug. Provides login, register, and logout UI backed by the Accounts std-include endpoints. Any app that needs auth: cite this chapter, include auth-css in the page, render auth-card-html and auth-who-html, then call auth-wire with your on-change callback.

author: reek
body: State keys: al (logged-in flag 0/1), ah (handle text). Token persists in localStorage under cx_tok.
